scientific_integrity: The entire two-variable series follows from the explicit all-length automaton invariant and six-state quotient, independently checked using finite exhaustive traces. The already-published VC dimension identity alone is not claimed novel. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns all inclusion-maximal independent sets of finite paths, not the exact online dimension or arbitrary graphs. Related indexed path/cycle findings were compared through accessible summaries, with their complete manuscript files unavailable; an equivalent uninspected treatment remains possible.
title: Exact shattering polynomial for maximal independent sets of paths
